leadText: Lapras (Japanese: ラプラス Laplace) is a non-player character in and .
plainText:
Lapras (Japanese: ラプラス Laplace) is a non-player character in and .

==In the games==
Lapras is first seen as a silhouette in a cut-scene when the and their are staring into a sunset sea. Later that night, another cutscene is shown where he is talking to , who tells Lapras that he can no longer keep his promise due to the threat of world destruction. It is later revealed that Wigglytuff had previously met Lapras in Brine Cave, when was severely injured after protecting Wigglytuff from an attack by two and a . Wigglytuff panicked and was unable to help his partner, but fortunately Lapras appeared in time to save Chatot. Lapras later explains that while he had not intended to reveal himself at first, he quickly changed his mind when he saw the unconscious Chatot. Afterwards, he tells Wigglytuff that he couldn't be sure whether they were good or evil, and simply asked that they did not investigate the strange pattern on the wall of Brine Cave. Grateful for his aid, Wigglytuff upheld the promise and ensured that all investigations on the matter ceased.

Later, when the hero makes their way to the pattern with and their partner, the partner's Relic Fragment reacts to the pattern on the wall and it sends a light out to sea, summoning Lapras. The three ride Lapras out into the ocean, whereupon Lapras explains more about reaching the Hidden Land, and how he met Wigglytuff. Lapras eventually crosses the Sea of Time, passing through the gaps between a second, before flying above the Hidden Land itself. He lands, and can be used from that point onwards as a permanent way of entering and leaving the Hidden Land (but only to the hero, the partner, and Grovyle). He explains how to reach Temporal Tower, before wishing the hero's team luck.

Lapras is briefly mentioned by after the planet's paralysis is halted, who tells the hero and partner that Lapras would be waiting for them. Following the hero's disappearance, the devastated partner makes the journey on Lapras back to Treasure Town alone.

During the post-game story, Lapras is a standard resident at the beach just south of the Guild. He offers comments at certain parts of the storyline, similar to Treasure Town's shopkeepers, and continues to provide free travel to the Hidden Land. When the hero and partner attempt to investigate the distortion of space, Lapras is able to offer some information, revealing to them the existence of and his domain, Spacial Rift. However, Lapras does not know where that is or how to get there.

After the post-game story is finished, Lapras continues to remain on the beach, where he expresses concern and apologises for not knowing about 's "accident" with the waves.

==In animation==
 ]]
In Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness, Lapras carried Piplup, Chimchar, and Grovyle to the Temporal Tower.
 

==In the manga==
 
 
===Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team===
Lapras appeared in BET5.
 

==Trivia==
Unusually, Lapras is not present at the beach when Miracle Sea is unlocked, briefly making the Hidden Land and Temporal Tower inaccessible. Although he returns after the player clears the dungeon, no explanation is given for his absence.
If the player goes to Lapras to return to Treasure Town after Grovyle returns to the future, Lapras will notice his absence and say something.
